text:
Liam: PSA - the microwave beeps like a funeral drum. Can we start a 3-note timer contest? :musical_note:
Ava: Ooh yes. 3 notes only. Winner gets to rename the microwave. :trophy:
Maya: Proposal: use the descending ding-ding-dong. Runner-up contributes chocolate. :chocolate_bar:
Ethan: I submit my entry: beep-boop-BEEP (imagine a robot opera). :robot_face:
Priya: I'll judge on emotional range and ability to wake sleepy interns. :sleeping:
ops-bot: POLL created — "Microwave Timer Theme" Choices: Robot Opera / Descending Ding / Tiny Fanfare. Vote with reactions.
Liam: Also bonus points for harmonizing with someone's lunch opening. :lips:
Ava: If Robot Opera wins, we all get robot nicknames. I call 'Liamtron'. :smile:
Maya: If Descending Ding wins, microwave becomes "The Oboe of Justice". :oboe:
Ethan: Tiny Fanfare is my dark horse pick. Short, dignified, minimal calories. :confetti_ball:
Priya: Poll ends at 3pm. Loser buys communal tea bags. :tea:
Liam: Challenge accepted. May the best 3 notes win. :muscle:
